headline: The oil drum bites back
lede: DONKEY KONG's flame is no longer decor: fireballs light at the drum on a clock, walk the tower up the ladders, and burn — while the counter-zero grab becomes a scripted little drama with a heart that shatters.

notes.text: Fire oil shipped (#3796/#3811): the drum lights a fireball 7 s in, then one per 20 s (max two). It climbs every sound ladder, kills on contact through the same freeze/terminal laws as barrels, smashes under the hammer, pays the house obstacle bonus, and speeds up each banked lap — Wikipedia's three sourced laws, dice-free so every seeded barrel floor is byte-identical.

The capture grab is a scene now: the ape's arm visibly reaches, Pauline is dragged above the rung columns (the old slide cut through a ladder mid-air), then carried down at the girder end — and the heart between them pops and breaks, straight from the arcade's own plot.

Proof without slack: kongcheck 217/0 with every existing floor verbatim — the 24-seed fleet passes with fire live at the inherited zero-death and no-capture floors; the seat learned the evasion as game code. Manual mutant of the kill-box turned 4 checks red. Kongdrive 21/21 in real Chrome: live burn, live light, live climb.
The warden's target came first (forge-claim 3796 a), shipped, prod-verified, and closed. #3815 asks the QA lane for the human-feel pass on the new hazard.
